basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old based in Miami, Florida, working as a freelance graphic designer. I love exploring new tech gadgets and have recently developed an interest in home gardening, which is why I'm a regular at IGPods and UKPlantSwap. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility that freelancing offers. My online hours are typically late at night, thanks to my nocturnal work habits. I'm not a fan of overly crowded places and prefer quiet, peaceful environments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a state university. Most of my knowledge comes from hands-on projects and online courses. I also dabble in tech forums to stay updated on the latest industry trends.
